programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Third From the Sun
programmes.d: With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programmes.d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Hitch-Hiker
programmes.d: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Fever
programmes.d: Tight-fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programmes.d: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Purple Testament
programmes.d: Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Elegy
programmes.d: Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mirror Image
programmes.d: Millicent Barnes sees her double at a bus terminal.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
programmes.d: Paranoia strikes the residents of Maple Street when they believe human-looking aliens have invaded the neighborhood.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A World of Difference
programmes.d: Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Long Live Walter Jameson
programmes.d: Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: People Are Alike All Over
programmes.d: When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Execution
programmes.d: Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, a man in 1880 is transported into the year 1959 by a professor who soon realizes that he has brought forward a savage killer.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programmes.d: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programmes.d: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programmes.t: Apartment 1303
programmes.d: Sammen med sine venner fejrer Janet (Julianne Michelle) at hun er flyttet ind i sin nye lejlighed på 13. etage, men i løbet af aftenen springer hun uventet ud fra altanen og begår selvmord.

programmes.t: Boarding School
programmes.d: Da den problemplagede 12-årige Jacob Felsen bliver sendt på kostskole, træder han ind i ethvert barns værste mareridt. En uhyggelig gammel herregård, der er helt forladt bortset fra seks andre teenageoutsidere og to truende og mystiske lærere.

programmes.t: White Dog
programmes.d: En ung skuespillerinde finder en hvid hund, uvidende om, at den er blevet trænet til at angribe sorte mennesker.

programmes.t: The Wraith
programmes.d: Jake bliver dræbt af kvarterets bøller og vender tilbage som en mystisk figur (The Wraith) for at få hævn.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programmes.d: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: You Drive
programmes.d: Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Long Morrow
programmes.d: Before leaving on his mission, an astronaut meets a woman. They fall in love...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Self-Improvement of Salvadore Ross
programmes.d: A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
programmes.d: In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Black Leather Jackets
programmes.d: Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
programmes.d: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: From Agnes - With Love
programmes.d: A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
programmes.d: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programmes.d: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile
programmes.d: Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What's in the Box
programmes.d: A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
programmes.d: On the day an unpopular idealist is to be executed for the killing of a racist bully, the townsfolk are shocked to see the skies have turned pitch black.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: If She Dies
programmes.d: A year after his wife died a man is involved in a car accident that leaves his young daughter in a coma. On his way home the man has a vision.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Ninety Years Without Slumbering
programmes.d: An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programmes.d: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: You Drive
programmes.d: Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Night of the Meek
programmes.d: After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag, he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
programmes.d: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What You Need
programmes.d: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.
